code.originalText: Six-month recovery, alcohol, liver, and mood review

text.paragraph: Six-month recovery, alcohol, liver, and mood review. [S]

Ms. Holiday returns six months after starting buprenorphine. She has taken 16 mg every day since the return to use before the three-month visit and has used no heroin or other opioids for three months. The early refill and travel letter worked on her last tour. She drinks one drink on some performance nights and none otherwise. Her dental abscess was drained by the dentist the week of her sick visit, and the tooth has since had root canal treatment; she finished the amoxicillin and needed the pain tablets for only three days. She sleeps better and enjoys singing again. She sees her counselor weekly and her peer recovery coach every two weeks. [S]
